files.contents:
<script>
	import { Module, Action, Bubble, Divider, Reply } from 'mercury';

	let messages = $state([
		{ text: 'Coffee this week? I miss our chats', time: 'Mon 6:12 PM', outgoing: false },
		{ text: 'Yes! How about tomorrow?', time: 'Mon 6:20 PM', outgoing: true },
		{ text: 'Kettle & Kite at 3? I can do until 4', time: '9:41 AM', outgoing: false }
	]);

	let confirmed = $state(false);

	function send(text) {
		if (!text?.trim()) return;
		messages.push({ text: text.trim(), time: 'Now', outgoing: true });
	}

	function confirm() {
		if (confirmed) return;
		confirmed = true;
		send('Perfect, see you at 3 tomorrow!');
	}
</script>

<Module title="Mara Okafor" source="Messages" kind="social">
	{#each messages as m, i}
		{#if i === 2}
			<Divider label="New messages" />
		{/if}
		<Bubble text={m.text} time={m.time} avatar="MO" outgoing={m.outgoing} />
	{/each}
	<Reply placeholder="Message Mara" onsend={send} />

	{#snippet actions()}
		<Action
			primary
			label={confirmed ? 'Confirmed' : 'Confirm 3 PM'}
			icon={confirmed ? 'check' : 'arrow'}
			onclick={confirm}
		/>
		<Action label="Suggest another time" onclick={() => send('Could we push to 3:30?')} />
	{/snippet}
</Module>
